title: The Price of Sparsity: Sufficient Conditions for Sparse Recovery using Sparse and Sparsified Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2509.01809v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of support recovery for sparse binary signals from noisy linear measurements. For sparse Gaussian measurement matrices we identify sufficient conditions on the minimal sample size for maximum-likelihood recovery in the high-SNR regime $ds/p \to \infty$, where $p$ denotes the signal dimension, $s$ the number of non-zero components of the signal, and $d$ the expected number of non-zero components per row of measurement. Combined with known lower bounds, this yields an information-theoretic threshold of order $s\log(p/s) / \log(ds/p)$, making explicit the price of measurement sparsity. In particular, we highlight a regime where the sample-complexity loss from measurement sparsity is logarithmic while the computational gain is nearly linear. translated_title: 稀疏性的代价：使用稀疏与稀疏化测量进行稀疏恢复的充分条件
translated_abstract: 我们研究从含噪线性测量中对稀疏二元信号进行支撑恢复的问题。对于稀疏高斯测量矩阵，我们在高信噪比区间 $ds/p \to \infty$ 下确定了最大似然恢复所需最小样本量的充分条件，其中 $p$ 表示信号维度，$s$ 表示信号非零分量的数量，$d$ 表示测量矩阵每行非零分量的期望数量。结合已知的下界，这给出了阶为 $s\log(p/s) / \log(ds/p)$ 的信息论阈值，从而明确揭示了测量稀疏性的代价。特别地，我们强调了一种区间，在该区间中测量稀疏性导致的样本复杂度损失是对数级的，而计算增益接近线性。其次，我们研究了对原始稠密高斯设计进行稀疏化后的恢复问题：观测数据由稠密设计生成，而估计则使用一个独立的（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文确定了在高信噪比区间使用稀疏高斯测量矩阵进行稀疏二元信号支撑恢复所需最小样本量的充分条件，给出了阶为 $s\log(p/s)/\log(ds/p)$ 的信息论阈值，明确量化了测量稀疏性的代价，并指出存在一个测量稀疏导致对数级样本复杂度损失却换来近线性计算增益的区间。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sufficient conditions on the minimal sample size for maximum-likelihood support recovery of sparse binary signals from sparse Gaussian measurements in the high-SNR regime, yields an information-theoretic threshold of order $s\log(p/s)/\log(ds/p)$ that makes explicit the price of measurement sparsity, and highlights a regime where the sample-complexity loss is logarithmic while the computational gain is nearly linear.
